description:
[measured] Smart money on Hyperliquid: how whale wallets are positioned and what they did.
    Per coin: whale accounts long vs short, notional and leverage per side, notional within 5% of
    its liquidation price, and the flow over the window (what the same wallets added and cut,
    in coins valued at today's mark, so a price move is not counted as buying), plus the largest
    wallet moves with addresses. From hourly snapshots of ~13,600 accounts with exchange-reported
    liquidation prices. Large is not the same as right: positioning, not a signal. Look up any
    address from top_movers with get_hl_account. Priced: $0.03 per call (x402), 6 prepaid
    credits, or a key's quota.
